Every claim carries evidence; [V] = read in source, [I] = inferred. Completeness is enforced by test/crosscheck.test.mjs.

creatorRule.definition: An EXECUTIVE may see and act on a BD site only if sites.submitted_by = me OR sites.assigned_to = me ('owns or is assigned'). Supervisors, business admins and observers are tenant-wide. Module executives (legal, design, project_excellence, project, financial_closure, quality_audit) are scoped by per-site delegation instead. The Launch 'creator review' applies the same identity test to ANY role.
